question: In March 2020, the Maharashtra Government approved the proposal to rename the airport of ______ after Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aurangabad.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In March 2020, the Maharashtra Government certified the proposal to rename the **Aurangabad airport as 'Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj Airport'.**
 
• The airport is titled after** Shivaji (1630–1680),** a **17th-century Chhatrapati** of the Maratha Empire.
 
• It was relabeled in **1999 from the preceding "Sahar Airport" to "Chhatrapati Shivaji** **global Airport**" (the title "Maharaj" was placed on **30 August 2018).**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Airport Amravati** is situated in **Belora,15 km** south of **Amravati, Maharashtra, India. **
 
• **Jalgaon Airport** is situated 6 Km far from the city of Jalgaon and the nearest airport from Jalgaon is the Aurangabad domestic airport.
 
• **Kolhapur Airport** also popular as **Chhatrapati Rajaram Maharaj Airport** is a regional airport in Kolhapur, Maharashtra, India.**​ **
